simple.meaning: נָזַל (nâzal) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to drip , or shed by trickling.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 16 times in Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, Job, and 5 more, beginning at Exodus 15:8. The surrounding contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָזַל (H5140) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נָזַל (nâzal) / H5140 is traced through Exodus 15:8, Numbers 24:7, Deuteronomy 32:2, Judges 5:5 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to drip , or shed by trickling
definitions.usage: distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.
definitions.full: H5140. nazal [ נָזַל ] verb flow, trickle, drop, distil (poetry) ( נְזַל ᵑ7 of flowing water; Syriac descendit, defluet PS 2331 ; Arabic descend (.milk into udder, but also in General)); — Qal Perfect נָָֽזְלוּ Judg 5:5 ; Imperfect יִזַּל Num 24:7 etc; Participle נֹזְלִים Exod 15:8 +, etc.; — 1 flow subject water, Num 24:7 (JE); Psa 147:18 ; compare Jer 18:14 ; subject clouds, Job 36:28 followed by rain as accusative of material Ges § 117z (|| רעף and, 36:27 , זקק ), compare Jer 9:17 (of eyelids); so .fig. Isa 45:8 followed by צֶדֶק (|| רעף ); of mountains (i.e. their torrents) Judg 5:6 according to ᵑ9 Ew GFM and others, but see I. זלל especially participle as substantive, = streams, floods , Exod 15:8 (|| תהום מים, of Red Sea); Psa 78:44 (|| יְאֹר ); for drinking 78:16 (|| תהום כַנהרות, מים 78:15 ), Prov 5:15 out of well (|| מים ); for irrigation Isa 44:3 (|| מים ); figurative of Shulamite ׳נ מִןלְֿבָנוֺן Song 4:15 (|| מים באר גנים, מעין ) 2 distil , of spices בְּשָׂמִים Song 4:16 ; figurative of words, like dew Deut 32:2 (|| ערף ). Hiph`il Perfect lyZIhi Isa 48:21 cause to flow , water from rock (|| זוב ). — See also I. זלל . נזם (√ of following; meaning unknown).

occurrences.englishText: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up.
Water shall flow from his buckets.
My doctrine will drop as the rain.
He brought streams also out of the rock,
he turned their rivers into blood,
He sends out his word, and melts them.
Drink water out of your own cistern,
For I will pour water on him who is thirsty,
They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts.
Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field?
